description: This file contains utility methods for aiding debugger sessions within the Orleans runtime, specifically providing a method to retrieve grain instances from grain references during debugging.

classes.name: OrleansDebuggerHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to assist with debugging Orleans grain references.

methods.name: GetGrainInstance
methods.description: Returns the grain instance associated with a given grain reference if it is activated on the current silo.
